• ISO 20022 Migration with Trade360 
• The project centers on the implementation of ISO 20022 messaging standards within Barclays UK’s Trade360 
application, ensuring compliance with global payment modernization initiatives. Trade360 supports both SWIFT 
MT messages (MT101, MT103, MT202, etc.) and ISO 20022 MX messages (Pain.001, Pacs.008, Pacs.009, 
Camt.052, Camt.053, Camt.056, etc.), enabling seamless interoperability across payment schemes. As a Business 
Analyst, responsibilities include impact analysis across applications (GPP, Trade360, IMI, TMIL) and schemes 
(Fedwire, CHIPS, CHAPS), driving migration readiness, regulatory alignment, and operational efficiency.

• HSBC Trade Portal & ISO 20022 Migration 
• The project delivers the Trade Portal solution for HSBC, enabling customers to submit and track Documentary 
Credit and Import/Export Collection transactions with attached documents. Production users can review submissions, 
verify customer credit limits, issue Letters of Credit, perform AML/compliance checks, and generate SWIFT 
messages aligned with international trade finance standards. The solution also integrates FX capabilities, allowing 
staff to book cross-currency deals during transaction processing. 
• From a migration perspective, the project ensures transition from legacy SWIFT MT messages (MT103, MT202, 
MT900, MT910, MT940, MT950) to their corresponding ISO 20022 MX formats (Pain.001, Pacs.008, Pacs.009, 
Pacs.002, Camt.052, Camt.053, Camt.056). This migration enhances interoperability, regulatory compliance, and 
future-proofs HSBC’s trade finance operations under the ISO 20022 framework.
